title: The trace cone classifies Razak–Jacelon stabilizations
summary: We prove that the canonical topological cone of all extended lower-semicontinuous tracial weights determines a separable nuclear C ∗ -algebra after tensoring with the Razak–Jacelon algebra and the compact operators, answering Robert's trace-cone classification question positively. The isomorphism realizes the prescribed cone map, with arbitrary ideal structure and without a density assumption on the finite domains of the weights.

review.reason: Shows the trace cone classifies C*-algebras after Razak-Jacelon stabilization, answering Robert's question.
